These two unmodified pure settings helpers come from petedevries666/lumaz,
commit e148b7f04c864b422c067b055d104b6fbd6e86ca, src/audio_playback.py and
src/midi_routing.py. They are production-code compatibility fixtures, not installed
by the AZ installer. Hardware uses its own installed /root/*.py helpers.
MPV, JACK-port enumeration, systemd, Webconf login and RFB are explicitly test
peripherals. No Raspberry Pi hardware validation is implied.
